description.title: שירותי רכב חלופיים
description.summary: This table details the alternative vehicle services provided to the insured during the insurance period, particularly in the event of an accident. It outlines the conditions for receiving a replacement vehicle and how the duration of service is determined.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת שירותי רכב חלופיים הניתנים למבוטח במהלך תקופת הביטוח, במיוחד במקרה של תאונה. השירותים ניתנים ללא תוספת תשלום ומספר הפניות מוגבל. במקרה של תאונה הגורמת להשבתת הרכב במוסך, ספק השירות יספק רכב חלופי מחברת השכרה. מספר הימים לקבלת הרכב החלופי תלוי במספר הימים הנדרשים לתיקון הרכב הפגוע, כפי שנקבע בדוח השמאי. שירותי רכב חלופיים, תיקון רכב, דוח שמאי, חברת השכרה.

sketch:
A. Substance of the services
The service provider will provide the insured with alternative vehicle services as detailed in the alternative vehicle service document hereunder, in the course of the insurance period.
The insured will be entitled to the following services, for no consideration and without a limit on the number of its requests in the course of the insurance period.
In the event of an accident -in accordance with the following conditions (if accidental cover is purchased in the insurance policy):
In the event of an accident which results in the lay-up of the insured 's car, in a garage for repair, the service provider shall provide the insured with an alternative vehicle from a hire company, to which the insured will be referred by the service provider (hereinafter the "car hire company").
The alternative vehicle will be provided after the damaged vehicle is examined by a certified surveyor.
Determining the number of days for receipt of the alternative vehicle is conditional on the number of days required to repair the insured damaged vehicle.
The number of days will be determined on the basis of the surveyor's report which shall be submitted as follows: the cost of repair work of the insured vehicle (excluding spare parts) divided by the price of one day work (8 hours) at the garage (in accordance with the Garage Association hourly tariff valid at the time of the repair).
The alternative vehicle will be provided in accordance with the surveyor's report as noted in paragraph 4 above, which shall note the number of days required to repair the damaged vehicle, less 3 days (unless otherwise noted in the insurance specification.
